sources.description: Loop engineering for AI coding agents — turn ad-hoc sessions into a repeatable research → plan → wave-execute → close loop with verification gates. Runs on Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, and Pi. MIT community plugin.
🔁 Build reliable recurring AI-agent systems: 601 resources, 20 operational patterns, 20 loop contracts, 8 runtime starters, an interactive atlas, and a structured dataset.

A universal collection of reusable Loop Engineering kits for AI coding agents—not just prompts. Each kit combines Skills, Rules, Templates, workflows, and validation loops to help agents autonomously plan, execute, verify, fix, and improve engineering tasks.

A curated guide to agentic engineering: building and shipping software by directing AI coding agents. Harnesses, context and loop engineering, spec-driven dev, evals, and real production case studies.
基于 Harness 和 Loop，使你的 AGENT 做事严谨、准确、可溯源。
